statements.execute_pure: execution of pure returns ok with the unchanged state
statements.execute_query: one command decides by its literal Rust outcome whether the adaptive continuation runs
statements.execute_bind: sequential execution: the continuation runs only after a successful complete prefix
statements.execute_fail: a failed command keeps its poststate and stops
statements.execute_div: a diverging command keeps its poststate and stops
statements.execute_congr: pointwise equal steps (reply and full state) execute equally
statements.execute_lift: execution of a lifted native implementation equals its full simulateQ run
statements.source_exact: a step proved equal to a lifted native implementation for every query and state executes as the native simulation
statements.source_continuation: source_exact under an arbitrary continuation of the complete result and state
statements.outcome_ok: (Claude, D-3) the adapter applied to a normal-returning computation is the lifted native result
statements.outcome_normal: (Claude, D-3) every supported adapted outcome of a normal-returning computation is ok with a supported native reply and poststate
statements.ofResult_ok: (Claude, D-3) a family of normal-returning executors adapts to exactly liftStep of the native implementation
statements.ofResult_normal: (Claude, D-3) every supported outcome of such an adapted family is ok; the entry-state placeholder is never supported
